objective: Evaluate a QMS document or evidence set against ISO 9001 clauses using AHP-supported weighted scoring. This template is decision support only and must not replace clause-specific audit judgement.

score_meaning.1: very weak evidence or severe gap

criteria.name: Context of organization and QMS scope
criteria.what_to_score: context, interested parties, QMS scope, process interaction, process responsibilities and controls

criteria.name: Leadership, policy and roles
criteria.what_to_score: leadership commitment, customer focus, quality policy, responsibility and authority

criteria.name: Planning, risk, opportunity and objectives
criteria.what_to_score: risk and opportunity planning, measurable quality objectives, change planning

criteria.name: Support, resources and documented information
criteria.what_to_score: resources, competence, awareness, communication, organizational knowledge, document and record controls

criteria.name: Operation and service delivery control
criteria.what_to_score: operational planning and control, customer requirements, design if applicable, external providers, delivery, release, nonconforming outputs

criteria.name: Performance evaluation
criteria.what_to_score: monitoring, measurement, analysis, customer satisfaction, internal audit, management review

criteria.name: Improvement and corrective action
criteria.what_to_score: improvement, nonconformity control, correction, corrective action, continual improvement evidence

matrix_note: This default reciprocal matrix derives weights C1=.10, C2=.15, C3=.15, C4=.15, C5=.20, C6=.15, C7=.10. Replace with auditor pairwise judgements when available and check CR.

alternatives.name: Uploaded QMS manual or evidence package

C1: Scope and process overview evidence; verify explicit ISO 9001 scope, exclusions and process interactions.
C2: Quality policy, quality objectives, organization chart or role assignment evidence.
C3: Risk management framework and quality objectives; verify measurable objectives and change planning.
C4: Document control, record control, HR, IT and communication evidence; verify competence and awareness records.
C5: Operational service delivery procedure evidence; verify end-to-end service controls and external provider controls.
C6: Performance monitoring evidence; verify internal audit and management review inputs/outputs.
C7: Improvement evidence; verify nonconformity, correction, root cause, corrective action and effectiveness records.

required_output_controls: Report AHP weights and consistency ratio before using weighted results.
If CR > 0.20, return ReviewRequired and do not finalize ranking.
Separate weighted score from audit verdict.
Use Complied, Noncomplied, InsufficientEvidence, ReviewRequired, ReferenceGap, OFI or OBS as verdict labels.
Never classify Major NC or Minor NC from the numeric score alone.
